title: Invitation from the Demonic Path
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was deep in thought, the letter personally written by the Demon Lord suddenly flickered with an eerie black light—a wisp of will beyond comprehension was sealed within, watching.

text.content: The Heart-Devouring Mark on Ye Qing's wrist squirmed like a living thing, seeping out wisps of black energy with each pulse. Her complexion, already pale, now held an added touch of death. I narrowed my gaze but didn't immediately speak. In my past life, I had seen records of this mark in ancient texts—a forbidden technique the Holy Sect used to control core disciples. Once activated, the host's soul would be bound to the sect's life token, their life and death hanging on another's whim.

dialogue.content: (Bitter smile) It seems the Holy Sect can't wait any longer... Chen Ji, don't worry about me, go ahead.

text.content: I didn't respond to her urging, merely walking closer slowly, my gaze fixed on the dark pattern. This pattern bore some resemblance to the 'Heavenly Fate Chains' recorded in the Tianji Record, yet was entirely different—more tyrannical, more bloodthirsty, as if it would uproot the host's vitality entirely. When Ye Qing saw I wasn't leaving, her brow furrowed, and just as she was about to persuade me again, a sinister laugh suddenly rang out from deep within the Bamboo Grove.

dialogue.content: (Without turning back) Come out. You've been following for so long, aren't your legs tired?

text.content: A black shadow darted from the bamboo shadows. The newcomer wore a black玄robed cloak, surrounded by faint demonic energy. After standing still, he didn't rush to speak, instead first sizing up Ye Qing, his gaze lingering on the Heart-Devouring Mark on her wrist. A teasing curve appeared at the corner of his mouth. I noticed a jet-black token hanging from his waist—the patterns on it matched the Holy Sect symbol Ye Qing had described, yet carried an additional air of ancientness and eeriness.

dialogue.content: (Squinting) Someone from the Holy Sect? Or perhaps... a Demonic Path envoy?

(Pulling back the cloak, revealing a sinister face) Chen Gongzi is indeed perceptive. Those old fossils at the Holy Sect have long become useless, can't even control their pawns. What intrigues me is you—a servant disciple from the Tianqing Sect, how did you manage to make our Saint Lady so devoted?

text.content: My heart stirred slightly. This person spoke without any regard for Ye Qing being present, even deliberately mentioning the Holy Sect before her, clearly acting with absolute confidence. More importantly, he actually knew about my cooperation with Ye Qing—this meant the Demonic Path's intelligence network was far deeper than I had anticipated. I kept my expression neutral, merely facing him calmly.

dialogue.content: (Calmly) Devoted? You're mistaken. Miss Ye Qing and I merely have a transaction of mutual benefit. As for your late-night visit, surely you didn't come specifically to watch us perform a tragic drama?
(Chuckles, producing a jet-black letter from his sleeve) Personal letter from the Demon Lord. Chen Gongzi, please examine it.

text.content: I took the letter, and the moment my fingertips touched the envelope, a cold aura rushed straight to my Mental Sea along my meridians. This aura... bore some resemblance to the remnant ancient will preserved within the Tianji Record. Without revealing anything, I opened the envelope, my gaze scanning the text within. The ink was like blood, each stroke seeming to contain overwhelming demonic might. As I read to the end, my pupils suddenly constricted—the letter actually mentioned that during ancient times, the true master of the Tianji Record was the Demonic Path's founding ancestor, 'Heavenly Demon'.

The Demonic Path's founding ancestor... Heavenly Demon... I silently recited this name in my heart. Mo Xiansheng once mentioned that during ancient times, there were two supreme powerhouses—one the incarnation of Heavenly Dao, the other the本体 of Heavenly Demon. Could it be that the Tianji Record was not a gift from the Heavenly Dao, but a遗落ancient fierce weapon? Ye Qing seemed to sense my unusual reaction and softly asked.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji faces a formal recruitment from the Demonic Path and must respond. The letter promises supreme status in the Demonic Path, but Ye Qing's Heart-Devouring Mark crisis remains unresolved. At this moment, he must weigh the pros and cons while not revealing his trump cards.

choices.description: Accept the Demonic Path's recruitment on the surface while secretly extracting more intelligence, especially regarding the connection between Heavenly Demon and the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as a Demonic Path pawn
choices.visible_reward: Gain access to the Demonic Path intelligence network
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, the Tianqing Sect will view you as a traitor

text.content: I tucked the letter into my sleeve, a teasing smile appearing on my face. Chenqian's kindness from the Demon Lord, I sincerely appreciate. However, this identity as a Tianqing Sect servant is rather convenient to use; discarding it rashly would be a waste. I wonder if your side has anything specific you need me to do?

dialogue.content: (Eyes flashing) Chen Gongzi is indeed a wise person. No need to rush leaving the Tianqing Sect, you only need to... pass us some information when necessary.

choices.description: Make no commitments, only express willingness to continue observing. Before Ye Qing's Heart-Devouring Mark is removed, avoid deep binding with any faction.
choices.visible_cost: Miss out on the superior conditions offered by the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as lacking sincerity

text.content: I handed the letter back to him, my expression calm. Chenqian is merely a废物, by what virtue do I deserve such厚爱from the Demon Lord? I remember your kindness, but this matter is of great significance—please allow me a few days to consider.

dialogue.content: (Frowning slightly, then恢复smiling) Chen Gongzi is indeed cautious. Very well, but the matter of the Heart-Devouring Mark cannot wait a few days.

choices.description: Utilize the different factions within the Demonic Path, dangling bait to make them destroy each other, while buying Ye Qing a chance to remove the Heart-Devouring Mark.
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence on Demonic Path internal factions

text.content: I suddenly chuckled, my tone carrying a hint of playfulness. I've heard the Demonic Path isn't monolithic internally; the Holy Sect and Demon Sect have longstanding grievances. Is your visit representing the Holy Sect, or do you have another backing?

dialogue.content: (Expression changing slightly) Chen Gongzi's intelligence is impressive. However, some things shouldn't be asked.

text.content: Just then, Ye Qing suddenly groaned, the Heart-Devouring Mark suddenly shining with blinding black light. Her figure swayed, dropping to one knee, cold sweat dripping from her forehead. The envoy unhurriedly took a jade bottle from his怀, tossing it to me casually.

dialogue.content: (Indifferently) This is the suppressant for the Heart-Devouring Mark, for now. In three days, I'll come again. By then, I hope Chen Gongzi can give me a satisfactory answer.

text.content: The black shadow vanished into the night. I caught the jade bottle, cold to the touch, faintly sensing the spiritual energy波动within. Ye Qing's breathing gradually steadied, but her gaze was异常复杂as she looked at the letter in my hand and Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: (Quietly) Chen Ji, are you really planning to... cooperate with the Demonic Path?

choice.prompt: Ye Qing asked the crucial question. She both hated and feared the Demonic Path, clearly worried that Chen Ji would walk the same old path of cooperating with the Holy Sect.

choices.description: Promise Ye Qing that under no circumstances will she be controlled by the Holy Sect again. This is sincere words and also a promise to her.

text.content: I handed the bottle to her, my tone平平淡yet exceptionally firm. I said mutual benefit was false. You help me conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, naturally I won't let you fall into demonic control again. As for the Demonic Path's invitation... it's merely a game where everyone has their own算盘.

dialogue.content: (Eyes reddening slightly, taking the bottle) Do you know... this is the first time I've heard someone say they would protect me.

choices.memory_label: 夜清开始真正信任陈机

choices.description: Don't answer directly, use more practical topics to divert focus. The most urgent matter is removing the Heart-Devouring Mark; everything else can wait.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain mystery, don't reveal true thoughts

text.content: I shook my head, not directly answering her question. Take the medicine first, everything else can wait. The matter of the Heart-Devouring Mark, I'll find a way.

dialogue.content: (A flicker of loss in her eyes, but still taking the bottle) ...Alright.

text.content: After Ye Qing took the解药, the light of the Heart-Devouring Mark gradually faded, but the dark pattern still coiled around her wrist like a dormant venomous snake. I knew this was merely a temporary measure—the Holy Sect wouldn't easily let go once they played this trump card. And the Demonic Path envoy's so-called 'three days' was clearly pressuring me.

I turned to look toward the Tianqing Sect, my mind rapidly calculating. The Demonic Path's offer this time was substantial; they opened with supreme status in the Demonic Path, which meant they were determined to get the Tianji Record in my hands. And the mention of 'Heavenly Demon' in the letter made me even more on guard—Mo Xiansheng never mentioned the Tianji Record being related to the Demonic Path's founding ancestor; how much had he concealed?

Just then, hurried footsteps came from outside the Bamboo Grove. A Tianqing Sect disciple stumbled over, face full of panic. Chen Shixiong! It's bad! The people from the Xuanwu Sect... they say they're清理门户, they've surrounded Han Shixiong! Han Lie—that most important chess piece I had positioned in the Tianqing Sect—was now in crisis. My gaze darkened, and the prophetic visions of Han Lie from the Tianji Record flashed rapidly—the Xuanwu Sect would experience internal turmoil in three days, and he was the trigger.

I took a deep breath and made my decision. The Demonic Path matter could wait, but Han Lie could not be lost. This chess piece, whom I had supported all the way to becoming the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, was the key fulcrum for prying open the dynamics of the three major sects. Once he fell, all the futures I saw in the Tianji Record Fragment would turn to ashes.
Ye Qing seemed to sense my unusual mood, about to ask, but saw I had already turned to walk out of the Bamboo Grove. She hurried to follow, the jade bottle clutched tightly in her hand.

I walked a few steps, then suddenly stopped, quietly saying to Ye Qing: Within three days, I will find a way to remove the Heart-Devouring Mark. Before then, do not act rashly. Since the Holy Sect dared to leave this mark on you, it means they've become suspicious of you. I will notify you of subsequent actions.

dialogue.content: (Nodding slightly) I understand. You... be careful.

text.content: I said nothing more, my figure flashing as I sped toward the Xuanwu Sect. The night wind brushed past my robes, carrying the faint spiritual energy fluctuation from afar. Han Lie, that idiot—even if his talent is higher, it's useless if his brain doesn't work. However... good, let me see what potential he can unleash in desperate straits. A true chess piece must withstand trials.

The night sky was dotted with stars, yet my heart was completely calm. The Demonic Path's invitation, the Xuanwu Sect's internal turmoil, Ye Qing's Heart-Devouring Mark... each and every one pointed to one fact: chaos is coming, and I must firmly grasp the fate of every chess piece in this game. The prophecies on the Tianji Record Fragment flickered constantly, and I had already seen the harbinger of the coming storm.
